rules.quarter: calendar quarter of the batch month (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec)
rules.note: Levels 3 to 6 (owner TEASER-STRICT): a sub-structure at most once per calendar quarter and also at least min_gap_days_across_quarters apart (circular); a family at most max_per_family_per_quarter times per quarter; an answer of 10 or more (and every text answer) once per level, a single-digit answer at most 4 times per level. Levels 1 and 2 (owner L1L2-GAP60): a sub-structure returns after at least min_gap_days days (circular over the year, leap and non-leap), a family at most family_max_in_window times in any family_window_days consecutive days and never on two consecutive days, an answer not twice within answer_window_days days and a single-digit answer at most answer_small_max_in_window times in that window. sub = the specific maths structure (what has to be worked out and how); family = the broad kind (topic). A different story or different numbers is NOT a different sub-structure.
